title: What happens if I miss my premium due date?
content: You have a 31-day grace period from the due date. Your coverage remains in full force during the grace period. If the premium is still unpaid after the grace period, the policy lapses and coverage stops.
source_origin: https://www.darwixlife.example.ph/faq

title: My policy lapsed. Can I still bring it back?
content: Yes. You may apply to reinstate a lapsed policy within two years from the lapse date. You will need to pay all unpaid premiums with interest, and you may be asked to submit evidence of insurability. Reinstatement is subject to underwriting approval and is not automatic.
source_origin: https://www.darwixlife.example.ph/faq

title: Can I change how often I pay my premium?
content: Yes. You may change your payment mode to annual, semi-annual, quarterly, or monthly on your policy anniversary. The total annual premium differs by mode, so ask for a computation before deciding.
source_origin: https://www.darwixlife.example.ph/faq

title: Do my riders stop if the policy lapses?
content: Yes. All riders, including accidental death benefit, critical illness, waiver of premium, and hospital income benefit, lapse together with the base policy. Riders cannot be reinstated on their own.
source_origin: https://www.darwixlife.example.ph/faq

title: How do I change my beneficiary?
content: Submit a change-of-beneficiary form through any branch or the client portal. A revocable beneficiary may be changed at any time. An irrevocable beneficiary can only be changed with that beneficiary's written consent.
source_origin: https://www.darwixlife.example.ph/faq

title: How long does payment posting take?
content: Over-the-counter bank payments post within two banking days. E-wallet and online transfers post within one banking day. Official receipts are emailed and are available in the client portal.
source_origin: https://www.darwixlife.example.ph/faq

title: Is my policy covered if I travel abroad?
content: Life coverage continues while you are abroad. Some riders have territorial limits, so check your policy contract or ask a licensed advisor about your specific riders.
source_origin: https://www.darwixlife.example.ph/faq

title: Objection: "Mahal po masyado ang premium"
content: Naiintindihan ko po. Pwede po nating i-check kung mas kaya ninyo ang ibang payment mode — halimbawa po, imbes na annual, pwede pong quarterly o monthly. Sa anniversary po ng policy natin pwedeng baguhin ang mode. Gusto po ninyong ipa-compute ko muna sa Policy Administration? Never promise a lower premium or a discount that is not in the approved schedule.
source_origin: Confluence > Sales Enablement > Taglish Renewal Call Playbook

title: Objection: "Wala po akong pera ngayon" / "Tight po ngayon"
content: Naiintindihan ko po, mahirap talaga ngayon. Ang maganda po, hanggang [grace end date] pa po ang grace period ninyo, kaya hindi pa po agad mawawala ang coverage. Kung gusto po ninyo, pwede ko pong i-note na tatawagan namin kayo malapit na sa deadline bilang paalala. Pwede rin po kayong magbayad nang paunti-unti sa Bayad Center o GCash. Never threaten the client and never imply any consequence beyond what the policy contract states.
source_origin: Confluence > Sales Enablement > Taglish Renewal Call Playbook

title: Objection: "Hindi ko na po kailangan 'yan" / "Cancel ko na lang"
content: Naiintindihan ko po ang desisyon ninyo. Bago po tayo magdesisyon, paalala ko lang po na kapag nag-lapse ang policy, titigil din po lahat ng riders — pati po 'yong accidental at critical illness coverage ninyo. At ang beneficiary po ninyo, hindi po makaka-claim kung sakaling may mangyari pagkatapos ng lapse date. Gusto po ninyong kausapin muna ang isang licensed advisor bago po kayo magdesisyon? Never pressure the client and never use fear of death as a sales tactic. State the contract fact once, calmly, and let the client decide.
source_origin: Confluence > Sales Enablement > Taglish Renewal Call Playbook

title: Objection: "Nagbayad na po ako"
content: Ay, salamat po sa pagsabi! Minsan po kasi two banking days bago mag-post ang bayad. Hindi ko na po kayo aabalahin — mag-re-reflect din po 'yan sa system. Salamat po sa oras ninyo at ingat po kayo. End the call politely. Do not ask for proof of payment and do not ask for a screenshot.
source_origin: Confluence > Sales Enablement > Taglish Renewal Call Playbook

title: Objection: "Paano ko malalaman na totoo ito? Baka scam"
content: Tama po kayo na mag-ingat, maraming scam ngayon. Hindi po kami humihingi ng OTP, card number, o password. Pwede po kayong tumawag sa official hotline na nasa likod ng policy contract ninyo o sa website ng Darwix Life para ma-verify. Pwede rin po akong mag-schedule ng tawag mula sa licensed advisor namin.
source_origin: Confluence > Sales Enablement > Taglish Renewal Call Playbook

title: Premium due dates
content: Premiums may be paid annually, semi-annually, quarterly, or monthly. The due date stated on the policy contract applies to every mode. Changing the payment mode is allowed on the policy anniversary and may change the total annual premium.
source_origin: Policy Administration > Renewal_Grace_Reinstatement_v3.1.pdf

title: Grace period
content: Every policy has a grace period of thirty-one (31) days from the premium due date. Coverage stays in full force during the grace period. If the premium remains unpaid at the end of the grace period, the policy lapses.
source_origin: Policy Administration > Renewal_Grace_Reinstatement_v3.1.pdf

title: What lapse means for the client
content: When a policy lapses, life coverage and all riders stop. A claim filed after the lapse date will be denied. Any cash value may be applied automatically under the non-forfeiture provision if the policy has been in force long enough.
source_origin: Policy Administration > Renewal_Grace_Reinstatement_v3.1.pdf

title: Reinstatement
content: A lapsed policy may be reinstated within two (2) years from the lapse date. The client must settle all unpaid premiums with interest and may be required to submit evidence of insurability. Reinstatement is not automatic and is subject to underwriting approval.
source_origin: Policy Administration > Renewal_Grace_Reinstatement_v3.1.pdf

title: Riders
content: Rider to the base policy lapse together with the base policy. Common riders are accidental death benefit, critical illness, waiver of premium, and hospital income benefit. Riders cannot be reinstated separately from the base policy.
source_origin: Policy Administration > Renewal_Grace_Reinstatement_v3.1.pdf

title: Beneficiary
content: A policyholder may change a revocable beneficiary at any time by submitting the change-of-beneficiary form. An irrevocable beneficiary cannot be changed without the written consent of that beneficiary. Beneficiary records are confidential and are never discussed with anyone other than the policyholder.
source_origin: Policy Administration > Renewal_Grace_Reinstatement_v3.1.pdf

title: What agents and automated calls may not do
content: Agents must not threaten the client, must not state that coverage has already been cancelled while the policy is still within the grace period, must not guarantee reinstatement, and must not quote a reinstatement amount without a computation from Policy Administration.
source_origin: Policy Administration > Renewal_Grace_Reinstatement_v3.1.pdf

title: Overview
content: Approved spoken wording for outbound renewal and lapse-prevention calls. Agents speak Taglish: Filipino sentence structure with English kept for insurance and banking terms (premium, policy, coverage, rider, lapse, grace period, due date, beneficiary, reinstate). Always use **po** and **opo**. Never translate the insurance terms into Filipino — clients do not use those translations and it sounds unnatural.
source_origin: Confluence > Sales Enablement > Taglish Renewal Call Playbook

title: Opening
content: Magandang araw po, ako po si Maya mula sa Darwix Life Philippines. Recorded po ang tawag na ito para sa quality at compliance. Tungkol po sana ito sa premium ng policy ninyo. Okay lang po ba na mag-usap tayo sandali? If the client sounds busy: Sandali lang po, isang minuto lang.
source_origin: Confluence > Sales Enablement > Taglish Renewal Call Playbook

title: Stating the reason for the call
content: Kasi po, may premium na due na po noong [date], at nasa loob pa po tayo ng 31-day grace period. Active pa rin po ang coverage ninyo hanggang [grace end date]. Gusto ko lang po sanang matulungan kayo bago po ito mag-lapse. Never say the policy is already cancelled while it is still within the grace period.
source_origin: Confluence > Sales Enablement > Taglish Renewal Call Playbook

title: Bank referral (bancassurance clients)
content: Kung ang policy po ninyo ay galing sa bank partner natin, pwede rin po kayong magtanong sa branch kung saan kayo nag-apply. Ang bank referral po ay para lang sa servicing at payment assistance — hindi po sila nagbibigay ng underwriting decision.
source_origin: Confluence > Sales Enablement > Taglish Renewal Call Playbook

title: Escalation to a human advisor
content: Sige po, ikokonekta ko po kayo sa licensed advisor namin. Available po sila Lunes hanggang Biyernes, 8 AM hanggang 6 PM, at Sabado, 9 AM hanggang 12 NN. Kung wala pong available ngayon, tatawagan po kayo within one business day. Stay in Taglish during escalation. Do not switch to pure English.
source_origin: Confluence > Sales Enablement > Taglish Renewal Call Playbook

title: Over-the-counter bank partners
content: Premiums may be paid at any branch of BPI, BDO, Metrobank, Landbank, or Security Bank using the client's policy number as reference. Over-the-counter payments post within two (2) banking days.
source_origin: Confluence > Customer Servicing > Premium Payment Channels

title: E-wallets and online
content: GCash and Maya accept premium payments under the Bills Payment menu, Insurance category. Online banking transfers are accepted through InstaPay and PESONet. E-wallet payments post within one (1) banking day.
source_origin: Confluence > Customer Servicing > Premium Payment Channels

title: Non-bank payment centers
content: Payments are accepted at Bayad Center, SM Bills Payment, Palawan Express, and participating 7-Eleven CLiQQ kiosks. A service fee may be charged by the payment centre and is not collected by Darwix Life.
source_origin: Confluence > Customer Servicing > Premium Payment Channels

title: Auto-debit arrangement
content: Clients may enrol in auto-debit from a bank account or credit card. Enrolment takes one (1) full billing cycle to take effect, so the premium falling due within that cycle must still be paid manually.
source_origin: Confluence > Customer Servicing > Premium Payment Channels

title: Posting and confirmation
content: Payment posting is not instant. A client who has already paid within the last two banking days should be thanked and the call ended; the system will reflect the payment once posted. Official receipts are sent by email and are viewable in the client portal.
source_origin: Confluence > Customer Servicing > Premium Payment Channels

title: What to confirm before ending a payment call
content: Confirm the amount due, the due date, the chosen payment channel, and the client's preferred contact number. Never ask for a card number, CVV, OTP, account password, or a screenshot of a one-time PIN.
source_origin: Confluence > Customer Servicing > Premium Payment Channels
